note: Curated fields with field-level sources. Only facts the cited source states are recorded. Sources checked on verifiedAt. Fields not listed stay unknown.

openingHours.note: Goa Government listing: Sunday 10.30-18.30, weekdays 9.00-18.30. May close to tourists during religious observances (e.g. Holy Week).
Incredible India (Ministry of Tourism): 9 AM-5 PM, closed Fridays. Third-party listings disagree on hours.

costs.note: Adult fee; children up to 15 free. Foreign-national fee not confirmed by an official source.

seasonal.text: The Goa government closes the Dudhsagar vehicle (jeep) circuit each monsoon from early June (notices dated 11 June 2023 and 1 June 2024). Reopening after the monsoon is reported from October.
seasonal.note: Closure start is official; the June-September month range is a TripWeaver reading of the notices and reopening reports.

costs.note: Jeep safari seat price from a press report, not an official fee notice. Confirm with GTDC.
